name: fluidmeet
description: Read your FluidVoice / FluidMeet meeting transcripts and summaries in Claude - locally and read-only.
long_description: Lets Claude list, search and read the meetings you recorded with FluidVoice (FluidMeet) on this Mac. It calls FluidVoice's bundled read-only helper `fv-serve`; nothing leaves your Mac except what Claude reads into the conversation, and no files are accessed directly. Requires FluidVoice with FluidMeet. In FluidVoice, open FluidMeet settings > Integrations and allow agent access first.

fv_serve_path.title: Path to fv-serve
fv_serve_path.description: Only change this if FluidVoice is not installed in /Applications.

tools.name: meet_list
tools.description: List recorded meetings (newest first) with ids, dates, speakers and titles.

tools.name: meet_show
tools.description: Read a meeting transcript, optionally only a time window (from/to).

tools.name: meet_summary
tools.description: Return summaries already saved in FluidVoice for a meeting.

tools.name: meet_search
tools.description: Search transcripts for text; returns matching lines with timestamps.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check whether FluidVoice meetings are accessible.

tools.name: skill
tools.description: Return FluidVoice's own usage guide for fv-serve.
